exa.description: Official Exa hosted MCP; real keyless web search and page fetch with rate limits
exa.routingGuidance: Prefer this provider for candidate-declared GitHub or other overseas public URLs that the CN ECS cannot fetch directly. Search may include exact-identity domestic mirrors on gitee.com, gitcode.com, juejin.cn or blog.csdn.net; a name match alone never proves candidate ownership.

fetch.description: Official MCP reference fetch server; candidate-declared public URLs only
fetch.routingGuidance: Use direct fetch for candidate-declared URLs reachable from the CN ECS, especially gitee.com, gitcode.com, juejin.cn and blog.csdn.net. Do not choose direct fetch as the first option for github.com; prefer the hosted Exa provider.
